params.body:
Alain Vandevelde reported on 17 September, through the "iets werkt niet" button: *"Het is gelukt
voor de display modus, maar ik zie geen foto enkel gegevens"*. His message sat unread in `anomaly`
for two days; Beheer > Werking showed it.

**His data is fine.** All four of his showroom vehicles have photos, a primary one, and a
`media_version` on every row, and the path the slide reads gives bytes back today. It is the stored
slide that was wrong.

**Why.** `drawPhoto` falls back to the silhouette the moment the derived size cannot be read, and
the cache stores that slide under the vehicle's fingerprint. A fingerprint says *which* photo was
meant to be drawn, not whether it was — and it has to stay that way: it must be computable without
reading the photo, or every lookup costs a read from the bucket and a zip of two hundred vehicles
two hundred of them. So a silhouette drawn while the photo mill was still catching up stayed under
a fingerprint that never changes again. The same fingerprint goes into the zip manifest, so the
next zip read "unchanged" and kept the silhouette too.

**What it does now.** The slide says whether it missed a photo the vehicle actually has, and such a
slide is handed out but not kept: not in the cache, and its vehicle is left out of the manifest so
the next build draws it again. A vehicle with no photo row at all changes nothing — there the
silhouette *is* the slide, and it is stored like any other.

Rule R S2-7.18, finding
`2026-09-19-showroomslide-zonder-foto-blijft-eeuwig-in-de-cache`, two tests. Both checked by
removing the fix again: the first fails, which is the point of writing it.

**While I was in there**, the other report on that screen is already answered. Randy Heuten's
error 500 on a BMW 118i (18 September, 11:26) is
`PathPrefixer::prefixPath(): $path must be of type string, null given` — a Hexon photo row without
a file, finding `2026-09-18-hexon-wagen-500-bij-opslaan`, fixed in #557 the same afternoon. The
production log carries that error 52 times and the last one is 18 September at 13:52. Nothing
since.

Replaces #676, which was green on every check but built on a main from before #674 and #675.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: A showroom slide that missed its photo is not kept (replaces #676)
